 # READ THIS BEFORE YOU POST AN ISSUE!
- **Have you used the [search tool](https://github.com/xjjakm/NBT-Editor26.2/issues) to check whether this feature has already been requested?** If it has been, then consider adding more details or use cases to the existing issue instead.

- **Please keep the scope of each request focused on a single feature or closely related set of features.** This helps us break work into manageable tasks and track progress more effectively.

- **You can delete the content above after you finish reading this article.**

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Who would benefit from this feature?**
Describe the target users (e.g. map makers, mod devs, server admins) and how they would use it.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or reference links about the feature request here.
